messages:
maria: Quick alignment thread 1 — Acme pushed for a fast adaptive-routing rollout with strict SLA gates. Need to finalize plan today.

alex: Proposed rollout timeline: internal shadow (24h) -> 5% canary -> 25% hold -> 75% -> 100%. Hold durations: 2h, 6h, 12h, 48h.

simon: Gate thresholds proposal: P95 <= baseline * 1.12 over phase window, 5xx delta <= 0.04% absolute, model queue p99 < 35ms. Circuit-breaker: 10 consec failures in 5m triggers per-tenant fallback.

jess: Legal wants guaranteed 30m emergency rollback and a named on-call. Also request: Acme admins need a UI toggle to pause their cohort.

maria: We'll support per-tenant opt-in + tenant-scoped hold. Ops needs a global kill switch too.

alex: API sketch for opt-in/additional endpoints: POST /api/v1/flags/adaptive_routing/tenants/:tenant_id/optin and POST /api/v1/flags/:flag/tenants/:tenant_id/hold.

eva: Telemetry: add tags: routing_variant, cohort_id, decision_ts, upstream_queue_ms, model_latency_ms. Capture 1% trace sampling and 100% traces for failures > 500ms. Dashboards by region/cohort.

simon: Add runtime auto-fallback when shard has >10 failures in 5m OR p95 > baseline * 1.25 for 1h. Trigger immediate tenant opt-out and PagerDuty alert.

jess: Acme wants manual hold at 25% slice for SLA customers; product please confirm console UX.

alex: We'll surface tenant hold and opt-in and expose API. Devex to add quick start in Console.

ops-bot: created #incidents/adaptive-routing-3623456790.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled 2026-04-05T20:00Z; prod canary us-east-1 2026-04-06T02:00Z.

maria: Launch checklist: staging canaries pass smoke, telemetry validated, rollback playbook + on-call confirmed, console UX + API tested, Acme signoff.

eva: I'll publish dashboards and a regression query comparing p95 to 7-day baseline.

simon: I'll add circuit-breaker metrics to runtime and set up one-click kill switch in Ops Console.

jess: Sales/legal: need tenant list and signed addendum for first-slice opt-ins.

maria: Open actions: (1) SLO thresholds final (simon+eva) (2) console opt-in/hold UX (product+devex) (3) API & tests (alex) (4) sales/legal addendum (jess) (5) runbook & kill switch (simon). Preflight Friday 09:30 PT.

alex: I'll add staging smoke tests asserting routing_variant header + 5xx delta < 0.02%.

simon: Also recommend a 24h shadow mode default to collect quality signals before ramping.

maria: Locking plan after preflight unless objections. :thumbsup:
